```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(nlrFlow)
```

Robust and quantile engines are optional. They should be used to answer distinct scientific questions, not as automatic replacements for a poorly specified mean function.

```{r eval=FALSE}
raw <- nl_data("okra_growth_raw")
start <- list(Asym=18,k=.44,xmid=3.7)
nl_robust(fruit_length~Asym*exp(-exp(-k*(day_after_flowering-xmid))),raw,start)
nl_quantile(fruit_length~Asym*exp(-exp(-k*(day_after_flowering-xmid))),raw,start,tau=.5)
nl_quantile(fruit_length~Asym*exp(-exp(-k*(day_after_flowering-xmid))),raw,start,tau=.9)
```
